links.outcome: LLM accuracy versus neurosurgeons on differential diagnosis, main diagnosis, and treatment advice
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 >90% differential diagnosis accuracy, no significant difference from doctors; Doubao worse (P=0.01-0.02). Treatment accuracy 71.3-80.5%, significantly lower than doctors (P<0.05).
links.quote: For treatment recommendations, all models showed reduced accuracy (ChatGPT-4o: 80.5 %; DeepSeek-R1: 79 %; Doubao: 71.3 %), significantly lower than doctors (Whether in Chinese or English: P < 0.05).

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM performance between Chinese and English versions of the same cases (cross-lingual consistency)

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic and treatment decision performance of three commercial LLMs against neurosurgeons using retrospective outpatient cases without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
